label: 选择 TCP/IP 端口
js: (() => { const e=document.querySelector('[data-testid=printer-port-type]'); const s=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype,'value').set; s.call(e,'tcp'); e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return true })()

label: 设置 TCP 参数
js: (() => { const set=(sel,val) => { const e=document.querySelector(sel); const p=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set; p.call(e,val); e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); }; set('[data-testid=printer-port-host]','192.168.1.100'); set('[data-testid=printer-port-number]','9100'); return true })()
